name: NVM Manager
description: Control nvm (Node Version Manager) from Orca's sidebar: see the Node.js version pinned by the focused workspace's .nvmrc, pin another one, install, uninstall and set the default version.

screenshots.alt: NVM panel showing the focused workspace, installed Node.js versions with Pin, Default and Uninstall, and Node.js release lines
screenshots.caption: Pinned version, installed versions and Node.js releases

settings.title: NVM directory
settings.description: Leave empty to use $NVM_DIR or ~/.nvm. Set it if nvm lives somewhere else.

settings.title: Install when pinning
settings.description: Run nvm install after writing .nvmrc if that version isn't installed yet.
